_meta.source: Kimi research notes (2026-08-13) + official product pages
_meta.note: Facts only: print runs, reprints, anniversary context, headline chase cards, market history. No investment advice.

optcg-en-op-01-booster-box-wave1.en: Romance Dawn launched the One Piece Card Game in English in December 2022. Wave 1 boxes — the blue-bottom first print — sold out almost instantly and remain the grail box of the English game, trading far above every later printing.
optcg-en-op-01-booster-box-wave1.zh-TW: Romance Dawn 係英文版 One Piece 卡牌嘅創世彈（2022 年 12 月）。Wave 1 藍底首刷一開賣即斷貨，係英文版最具代表性嘅聖杯盒，價格遠拋離其後所有再刷。

optcg-en-op-01-booster-box-wave2.en: The white-bottom Wave 2 reprint of Romance Dawn met the launch shortage. Same card pool as Wave 1, but the print marking makes it a separate collectible — priced well below the blue-bottom first wave.
optcg-en-op-01-booster-box-wave2.zh-TW: Romance Dawn 白底 Wave 2 係應付首發缺貨嘅再刷。卡池同 Wave 1 一樣，但印刷標記令佢成為獨立收藏品，價格明顯低於藍底首刷。

optcg-jp-op-01-booster-box-wave1.en: The Japanese Romance Dawn box started it all in July 2022. Long out of print, buyback offers jumped from around ¥8,000 in late 2025 to over ¥30,000 in 2026 as the One Piece market re-rated its origin set.
optcg-jp-op-01-booster-box-wave1.zh-TW: 日版 Romance Dawn（2022 年 7 月）係成個 OPTCG 嘅起點。絕版多時，買取價由 2025 年底約 ¥8,000 升到 2026 年超過 ¥30,000，市場重新為「創世彈」定價。

optcg-jp-op-05-booster-box-std.en: Awakening of the New Era is the first-anniversary set and the most expensive Japanese One Piece box. It saw no meaningful reprint, and its signed-style Luffy chase cards carry six-figure yen buyback quotes.
optcg-jp-op-05-booster-box-std.zh-TW: 新時代の主役係一周年紀念彈，亦係日版 One Piece 最貴嘅盒。冇明顯再販，簽名風 Luffy 大熱卡買取報價達六位數日圓。

optcg-jp-op-11-booster-box-std.en: A Fist of Divine Speed (March 2025) was one of 2026's fastest risers — the comic-parallel Luffy pushed sealed demand while supply dried up within a year of release.
optcg-jp-op-11-booster-box-std.zh-TW: 神速の拳（2025 年 3 月）係 2026 年升幅最勁嘅日版盒之一——Luffy 漫畫背景異圖帶動需求，發售一年內市面貨源已乾。

optcg-jp-op-13-booster-box-std.en: Carrying On His Will marks the game's third anniversary. Its red comic-parallel Luffy became one of the most expensive One Piece cards ever listed, keeping sealed boxes in the spotlight.
optcg-jp-op-13-booster-box-std.zh-TW: 受け継がれる意志係三周年彈。紅色漫畫異圖 Luffy 成為歷來掛牌最貴嘅 OP 卡之一，令原盒持續受注目。

optcg-jp-eb-01-booster-box-std.en: Memorial Collection was the first Extra Booster — a reprint-flavored celebration set whose alternate arts made it a collector staple beyond the main series.
optcg-jp-eb-01-booster-box-std.zh-TW: Memorial Collection 係首個 Extra Booster，回顧向嘅紀念彈，異圖卡令佢喺主系列以外都成為收藏定番。

optcg-jp-prb-01-booster-box-std.en: The Best is a premium reprint booster: 10 packs of 10 cards, with a documented "GOD pack" that contains ten comic parallels. Multiple reprint waves keep quotes volatile.
optcg-jp-prb-01-booster-box-std.zh-TW: The Best 係 Premium 再錄包：一盒 10 包、每包 10 張，存在全漫畫異圖嘅「GOD パック」。多次再販令報價反覆。

ptcg-jp-s6a-booster-box-std.en: Eevee Heroes (May 2021) is the signature Sword & Shield era Japanese box. The Umbreon VMAX alternate art — "Moonbreon" — made this enhancement pack the most chased sealed product of its generation.
ptcg-jp-s6a-booster-box-std.zh-TW: イーブイヒーローズ（2021 年 5 月）係劍盾世代最具代表性嘅日版盒。月亮伊貝 VMAX 異圖（Moonbreon）令呢個強化擴充包成為成個世代最被追捧嘅未開封產品。

ptcg-jp-s7r-booster-box-std.en: Blue Sky Stream (July 2021) carries the Rayquaza VMAX alternate art. Shrink-wrapped boxes command a huge premium over unwrapped ones — the widest shrink gap in the hobby.
ptcg-jp-s7r-booster-box-std.zh-TW: 蒼空ストリーム（2021 年 7 月）收錄天空之龍 VMAX 異圖。有 shrink 同無 shrink 嘅價差係全界最誇張，完封盒溢價極高。

ptcg-jp-sm7-booster-box-std.en: Sky-Splitting Charisma (June 2018) hides the Lillie's Full Force secret rare — the card that turned this Sun & Moon set into one of the most valuable Japanese boxes ever printed.
ptcg-jp-sm7-booster-box-std.zh-TW: 裂空のカリスマ（2018 年 6 月）收錄「リーリエの全力」SR——一張卡將呢個太陽月亮彈推上史上最貴日版盒級數。

ptcg-jp-sv2a-booster-box-std.en: Pokemon Card 151 revisits the original Kanto dex with Kadabra's first card in 21 years. A 20-pack special format at ¥5,800 MSRP, it now trades near ten times its list price with extreme volatility.
ptcg-jp-sv2a-booster-box-std.zh-TW: ポケモンカード151 重製初代 151 圖鑑，仲有胡地相隔 21 年再登場。20 包特別規格、定價 ¥5,800，而家成交貼近定價十倍，波幅極大。

ptcg-jp-sv8-booster-box-std.en: Super Electric Breaker (October 2024) is the Surging Sparks source set. Japanese domestic quotes run far above US import prices — a live example of the JP/US spread this board tracks.
ptcg-jp-sv8-booster-box-std.zh-TW: 超電ブレイカー（2024 年 10 月）係 Surging Sparks 嘅日版來源彈。日本國內價明顯高過美國進口價，係本站追蹤日美價差嘅活例子。

ptcg-jp-m6-booster-box-std.en: Storm Emeralda (July 2026) is the newest Mega-era expansion, led by Mega Rayquaza. Fresh sets like this trade in a hype window — expect the widest daily swings on the board.
ptcg-jp-m6-booster-box-std.zh-TW: ストームエメラルダ（2026 年 7 月）係 Mega 世代最新彈，主打 Mega 烈空坐。新彈處於炒作窗口，日內波幅全板最大。

ptcg-en-swsh07-booster-box-std.en: Evolving Skies (August 2021) is the modern English grail box: nine Eeveelution alternate arts including Moonbreon. It is the most expensive mainline Sword & Shield box by a wide margin.
ptcg-en-swsh07-booster-box-std.zh-TW: Evolving Skies（2021 年 8 月）係現代英文版聖杯盒：九張伊貝家族異圖包括 Moonbreon，價格大幅拋離其他劍盾主系列盒。

ptcg-en-sv10-booster-box-std.en: Destined Rivals (May 2025) brings Team Rocket back to the English game. Trainer-owned Pokemon and villain nostalgia made it the strongest-selling Scarlet & Violet era box on release.
ptcg-en-sv10-booster-box-std.zh-TW: Destined Rivals（2025 年 5 月）將火箭隊帶返英文版。訓練家持有寶可夢加反派情懷，令佢成為朱紫世代開售最強嘅盒。

ptcg-en-bs-booster-box-std.en: The 1999 Base Set box is the origin artifact of the English hobby. Unlimited boxes still trade weekly at five-figure prices; first-edition boxes sit another tier above in auction-house territory.
ptcg-en-bs-booster-box-std.zh-TW: 1999 年 Base Set 原盒係英文版寶可夢卡嘅起源文物。Unlimited 盒每星期仍有五位數美元成交；1st Edition 更加係拍賣行級數。

ptcg-en-evo-booster-box-std.en: XY Evolutions (2016) reprinted Base Set art for the 20th anniversary. Cheap and everywhere at launch, it became the most actively traded vintage-flavored sealed box — roughly one sale every day.
ptcg-en-evo-booster-box-std.zh-TW: XY Evolutions（2016）為 20 周年重印初代畫面。當年平價大量，而家成為成交最活躍嘅懷舊向原盒，差唔多日日有成交。
